name: Attachment
overview: Scripture reveals that true attachment is rooted in a steadfast trust and reliance on the Lord, who promises never to forsake His people and is near to the brokenhearted (Deuteronomy 31:6; Psalms 34:18). This emotional attachment to God invites believers to call upon His name for salvation (Romans 10:13) and to seek His guidance and grace amid trials and temptations, as exemplified by Jesus' Spirit-led journey into the wilderness (Matthew 4:1). The parable of the prodigal son (Luke 15:11) further illustrates the depth of God's compassionate attachment to His children, calling them to a heartfelt relationship that transforms and secures eternal life (Mark 10:17).
